patch.value: Implemented in engine/repo.ts (writeMergeState atomic temp+rename; mergeAbort corrupt-state recovery with HEAD fallback) and vcs-commands.ts (conflicting_options guard before abort/continue branches, optional theirs/revision in the aborted envelope). Regression tests added in test/merge-conflict.test.ts and test/vcs-commands-edges.test.ts; each verified to fail against the pre-fix code and pass after. release:check exit 0, coverage 100/100/100/100, self-host bundle regenerated and byte-identical to committed source.

Fixed all three PR #27 review findings in engine/repo.ts and vcs-commands.ts. Finding 1: mergeAbort now catches a corrupt/unreadable merge state and recovers instead of throwing corrupt_merge_state (the stopped merge never moved HEAD, so HEAD names the pre-merge tree to restore; theirs/revision are omitted when the state could not be read), and writeMergeState is now atomic via a temp-file-then-rename in the control directory so an interrupted write can never leave the truncated state that made abort throw. Finding 2: flattenTree is computed once before the per-conflict marker filter instead of once per conflict, removing n full merged-tree walks; the tree is one fixed content-addressed id and the object store is not mutated during the scan, so the hoist is behaviour-preserving. Finding 3: vcs merge now rejects --continue and --abort passed together before either branch runs, so a mistaken combination no longer silently aborts and discards staged resolutions. Each finding has a regression test that fails against the pre-fix code: corrupt-state abort recovery (throws corrupt_merge_state), the marginal object-store read count for four extra conflicts (52 vs <36), and the --continue/--abort combination (silently aborts, handled true vs false). Full release:check passes (exit 0) with coverage 100/100/100/100.
